changes: New 75 g gross pecorino dose instead of 100 g ricotta salata, explicitly named. Unknown rind loss and salted pasta-water loss remain unmeasured. Stirring is active; basil is heated so frozen selected herbs are supported. Distinct fennel-orange and olive-almond salads retained.
recipes.content_review: Separat brynt aubergine vänds med pasta i basilika-tomatsås och toppas med lagrad pecorino. Skild från ugnsgratäng, köttsås och tomatfri ostemulsion.
